# Third party files

`mediapipe/face_mesh/` holds the unmodified MediaPipe Face Mesh files from the npm package `@mediapipe/face_mesh` version 0.4.1633559619.

Licence: Apache License 2.0, copyright The MediaPipe Authors. The licence text is at https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.

They are served from this folder so the identity check never loads code from an outside address.
